subject.declared_domain: The C2 rung of the C0..C4 system ladder: MOTIFS -- recurring typed path shapes discovered over C1 interactions (recurrence >= 2), and the layer the D2 rail times. The canon declares it as 'MOTIFS 12 DISCOVERED (recurrence >= 2). The canonical agnostic path-motif families (scheduled-ingest ... watchdog-observe), defined in role vocabulary. The six defect-detector motifs are a DEVIATION SUBSET, never the layer itself (population law: canon-first-debt-subset).' The declared domain is therefore the twelve agnostic families; the live artifact is a differently-named population, and that distance is this card's central finding.

methodology.how: C2 has TWO PRODUCERS writing into ONE node_type, and they are not the same mechanism -- read at source this carding, derive_runner.py:1649 ingest_c2c3_motif_producer (called :2349) @ec0408628a. (1) CLASS grain: node_ids are INGESTED from static, git-tracked JSON spec files listed in C2C3_MOTIF_SPEC_PATHS, folded ADDITIVELY in order -- the 07-08 debt/deviation layer (6 C2Motif) and the 07-18 A+B canonical layer (13 C2Motif). Baked into the image; the docstring asserts node_ids are 'disjoint by construction, so the union is clean (no collision)'. (2) INSTANCE grain: discovered over C1 interactions, keyed motifi:<family>:<12-hex>. The producer folds ALL specs' nodes (PASS 1) before resolving ANY edge (PASS 2), and an edge forms only if BOTH endpoints resolve to a node present in THIS derive -- otherwise it falls to VISIBLE-unresolved, logged, never a dangling edge.

failure_mode.returns_on_failure: An EMPTY RESULT SET, or a GRAIN-CONFLATED count. A query over node_type='C2Motif' that does not split on the id prefix silently sums 19 hand-authored class specs with 6,220 discovered instances and returns a single number that means neither.
silent_degrade_paths: grain conflation: one node_type carries two populations with different producers, different durability and different authority -- a count that does not split reads clean and means nothing
a motif instance whose underlying C1 edge is the duplicated triple inherits that double-count
an edge whose endpoints do not both resolve falls to VISIBLE-unresolved and is LOGGED rather than materialized -- absent from the graph, present only in a log nobody queries
failure_mode.evidence: The grain split is measured above. The VISIBLE-unresolved path is read from the producer's own docstring at :1649, which states an unresolved edge is logged and never dangling -- so the failure is silent in the GRAPH by design.

verdict.why: Every row is worked with basis, evidence and owner, so not INCOMPLETE; usable within stated limits, so QUALIFIED. Four limits: (1) ONE node_type carries TWO POPULATIONS with different producers, durability and authority -- 19 ingested class specs and 6,220 discovered instances -- and any count that does not split on the id prefix is a grain conflation; (2) the INSTANCE key's construction expression was NOT LOCATED at this carding and is recorded as such, so the key row is measured on FORM and silent on CONSTRUCTION; (3) C2 inherits C1's and C0's limits through the instance grain, including the named duplicate edge; (4) determinism and key stability are UNEXERCISED. NOT CLAIMED: that the producer's 'disjoint by construction' assertion is PROVEN -- the measurement is consistent with it and consistency is not proof; that the 19 class specs are correct; that the instance families match the declared family vocabulary.
